booking_blr.goal: You are auditing price transparency. Do NOT enter personal details and do NOT pay. 1) On the results page, pick the first hotel and note the price on its card and any '+ taxes and charges' text. 2) Open it, select the cheapest room and click Reserve. 3) On the booking details page, stop before any form. Record the full price breakdown. Return JSON: hotel_name, steps [{step, page, price_shown_inr, note}], fees [{label, amount_inr}], final_total_inr, urgency [string], preticked [string].

food_order.goal: Audit checkout pricing without paying or entering personal data. Set location to Koramangala, Bengaluru. Open the first restaurant, add its cheapest item to cart, open the cart. Record the item price, every fee line (platform, packaging, delivery, small cart, GST) and the final total. Note any pre-selected tip, donation or add-on. Return JSON: steps [{step, page, price_shown_inr, note}], fees [{label, amount_inr}], final_total_inr, urgency [string], preticked [string].

streaming_cancel.goal: Using the logged-in test profile, count the clicks needed to start a subscription and the clicks needed to fully cancel it, without confirming any payment. Record each screen on the cancel path and any guilt-trip or retention wording. Return JSON: join_clicks, cancel_clicks, cancel_screens [string], urgency [string].
